newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia asks Cuba to extradite fugitive.
newsitem.headline: Colombia asks Cuba to extradite fugitive.

text.p: Colombia asked Cuba on Wednesday to extradite the husband of a prominent congresswoman and supporter of President Ernesto Samper who is wanted on fraud and corruption charges in Bogota.

Foreign Minister Maria Emma Mejia said the request, for the extradition of Hernando Rodriguez, was formally made by her office early on Wednesday based on a previous request by the prosecutor-general's office.

Rodriguez, who was in charge of a fund created to pay off workers at a state-run company that closed in the late 1980s, is accused of multimillion-dollar fraud in connection with his handling of the fund and has been a fugitive from justice since last August.

His wife, Martha Catalina Daniels, is one of Samper's staunchest supporters in Congress and helped win the president's acquittal by lawmakers last year when he faced possible impeachment because of charges he used drug money to finance his 1994 campaign.
